تستأمنوا (form X)
# تَسْتَأْمِنُوا (tastaʔminū) /tas.taʔ.mi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
# تُسْتَأْمَنُوا (tustaʔmanū) /tus.taʔ.ma.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
